title: Diffusion chain rule for the carré du champ
source_anchor: Sinho Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling (2026-08-09), Definition 2.2.13 and Eq. (2.2.14), printed p. 54 / PDF p. 65: for f,g in the carré-du-champ domain and all scalar maps phi : R -> R, the displayed rule is Gamma(phi∘f,g)=phi'(f) Gamma(f,g). The source does not explicitly impose a global ContDiff hypothesis in the definition; the derivative notation phi' is made explicit in Lean through a pointwise HasDerivAt witness.
target_statement: Introduce an explicit-domain Samplinglib interface for Chewi's carré-du-champ diffusion chain rule, including closure of the declared Gamma domain under scalar composition whenever the derivative field appearing in the source formula exists, and a direct specialization Gamma(f'∘rho,rho)=f''(rho) Gamma(rho,rho). Do not fold the generator-form equivalence Eq. (2.2.15) into this cell.
consumers: Chewi Theorem 8.3.1 abstract simultaneous f-divergence dissipation

shared_floor_audit.notes: The mechanism is general stochastic-process mathematics and belongs under StochasticProcesses rather than a Chewi-specific namespace, but current cross-route evidence does not justify declaring a route:shared cell. The source speaks about the Gamma domain; Samplinglib's carreDuChamp function itself is total, so the new interface keeps an explicit observable domain and records scalar-composition closure instead of silently treating every function as admissible. A previous source-fidelity pass incorrectly read Definition 2.2.13 as explicitly quantifying only over smooth phi and temporarily imposed ContDiff R top phi. Re-reading the pinned PDF shows the definition says all phi : R -> R and writes phi' directly. The corrected Lean statement therefore keeps phi arbitrary and makes the derivative field explicit by requiring pointwise HasDerivAt witnesses. Previous focused/root evidence belongs to the superseded ContDiff statement and is not used to justify the corrected cell. The generator equivalent form in Eq. (2.2.15) remains separate because Chewi delegates the equivalence to Exercise 2.8.
